label: The Cogito's necessary concrete ground-ancestor witnesses a necessary concretum at w
meaning: On one profile m, world w and occurrence data, the premise supplies some bearer b of an occurring episode e and a ground-ancestor x of b that is concrete under m.concrete, exists at w and exists at every world accessible from w. The conclusion keeps that same x with the same three properties and drops b, e and the ancestry fact. The premise is the sense bridge from a thought occurring to something concrete existing: it asserts both of one witness chain, and the proof uses exactly its concrete-existence part. Necessity stays accessibility-relative and de re; nothing about all-world existence, uniqueness, underivedness or God follows. Declared an instantiation: it adds no warrant beyond the premise.
